bioghist.head: Biographical/Historical Information
bioghist.p: The Cemetery Board was established by law July 1, 1998. The seven member board authorizes the licensure of persons engaged in the "business of a cemetery company" as cited in section 54.1-2311 Code of Virginia. The requirements for licensure became effective in legislation on July 1, 2000.

odd.p: These records are part of the Virginia Dept. of Professional and Occupational Regulation record group (RG 17)

Electronic records in this collection are read-only and are only available in the Archives Research Room at the Library of Virginia. A file list is available through the online catalog entry and the link below in the finding aid. Copies are free of charge and may be requested while using the collection in-house. Copies may also be requested by contacting Archives Reference Services at Ask a Reference Question. Processing will take from 4-8 weeks.

accessrestrict.p: Confidential and Attorney Client Privileged correspondence between the Board and the Office of the Attorney General is restricted to those with the written permission of the Office of the Attorney General. Restrictions will be removed 50 years after the records were received by The Library of Virginia.

scopecontent.p: Minutes and related attachments documenting the meetings, activities, discussions, policy decisions, and recommendations of the Virginia Cemetery Board. Includes official board minutes, as well as agendas, draft minutes and other meeting materials. May also include informal fact finding committee minutes.

Electronic records often contain board meeting packets with various attachments and draft minutes, while paper records often include minutes only. There may be some duplication between paper and electronic records.

For transfers prior to 2012, records (starting in 2008) of individual boards were accessioned separately. After this, transfers of records included all boards, which were accessioned under one accession number. There is a separate finding aid for the later transfers with links provided below.

Board minutes, 2002-2003, are in electronic format (2.65 mb, 12 files, 7 folders; format: pdf). Includes minutes, 2003; and board meeting packets, 2002-2003. Board meeting packets include agendas, draft minutes from previous meeting, and Regulatory Review Committee draft minutes. May also include correspondence, inspection report statistics, and reports. For file inventory for this accession, see: Inventory (45081).
Board minutes, 2004, are in electronic format (.5 mb, 1 folder, 2 files; format: pdf). For file inventory for this accession, see: Inventory (44794).
